title: Fix FindInFiles handling of unicode identifiers
body: ## What problem(s) does this PR solve? FindInFiles does not properly handle unicode identifiers. When "Whole Words" is enabled, it may still match partial words if they contain unicode chars. The script editor's search handles it correctly. ## Additional information The fix is based on https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/ccb8004960b1638f5532048db6c33a0bf5f0769e/scene/gui/text_edit.cpp#L5322-L5323
